reasoning: The question asks whether the US, Russia, or China will detonate a nuclear device before April 1, 2026. As of March 6, 2026, only ~26 days remain. Evidence shows: (1) New START expired February 5, 2026, removing arms control constraints; (2) Trump announced intent to resume nuclear testing in October 2025, with Russia pledging reciprocal action; (3) Multiple sources discuss heightened nuclear tensions and arms race risks. However, no evidence indicates any of these nations has actually detonated a device since November 12, 2025. While Trump threatened testing resumption, actually conducting a nuclear detonation within 26 days would be extraordinarily rapid and unprecedented in modern times. The rhetoric is aggressive but detonation requires significant preparation. No credible reports suggest imminent testing. The probability of actual detonation in this short timeframe remains very low despite elevated tensions.
